name: codediffer
description: 2-/3-way diff for very large trees (~100 GB, files over 1 GB, local or on a network share), as MCP tools: compare in the background, page through bounded answers, open one file's diff or 3-way merge, port a change set onto a third tree, and write an HTML report.

interface.shortDescription: 2-/3-way diff of very large trees, as MCP tools.
